ivar: Ivar: broad sturdy elder male dwarf, long loose swept iron-grey hair down back, NOT tied ponytail. Full grey beard with central long bound lock and two shorter side bound locks, exactly three brass bands. Ochre collared waistcoat, cream rolled elbow-length sleeves, brown suspenders, broad brown belt, charcoal trousers, short brown leather boots, brown wrist bracers. Stern protective brows.
hedrik: Hedrik: cheerful broad round stocky adult male dwarf, shoulder-length chestnut-copper loose waves, dense ROUND full chestnut beard, upturned curled moustache. NO beard braids or beard rings. Red waistcoat over cream rolled elbow-length sleeves, brown suspenders, brown belt, dark trousers, short brown leather boots, brown wrist bracers. Warm broad face.
borin: Borin: broad heavily muscular stocky adult male dwarf, long loose swept dark-brown hair. Very full dark-brown beard gathered into one broad central lock with ONE engraved silver band. Slate-blue rolled elbow-length shirt, brown leather smith's bib apron ending at knees, brown belt, charcoal trousers, short brown leather boots, brown wrist bracers. Heavy stern brows.
eldric: Eldric: upright sturdy adult elder dwarf, narrower than the muscular smith, long loose swept silver-white hair and full beard with TWO bound side locks gold bands and central loose pointed lock, small round gold spectacles. Royal blue coat, cream standing collar, brown suspenders, broad belt, charcoal trousers, short brown boots, blue sleeve cuffs. Thoughtful kind mature face.
brann: Brann: broad compact adult male dwarf, long loose copper-brown hair, thick full russet beard with a SINGLE thick central braid tied by ONE brass band, broad moustache, patient mature face. Red open collar short-sleeved work jacket over cream shirt, brown suspenders, brown belt, charcoal trousers, brown wrist bracers, short brown boots.
